meta.title: The Mannyverse · Online Tabletop Games with GM Manny
meta.description: Weekly online Shadowdark, Mothership, and Mythic Bastionland with GM Manny. Strange mysteries, hand-drawn maps, and a community to come home to.
meta.og_image_alt: Colored-pencil, ink-hatched portrait of Dolg, a pale green-blue humanoid with a tall rust-orange conical cap, drooping mossy-green hair, pointed ears, and mismatched eyes, one blue and one violet. Heavy-lidded and unimpressed, he rests his chin on a thick hand inside a black circle outline. Beside him: "The Mannyverse. Some games feel cozy. Some feel awful in the best way."

hero.headline: Some games feel cozy. Some feel awful in the best way.
hero.subhead: Online tabletop games, hand-drawn maps and monsters, and zines from GM Manny and the Gold & Glory crew.

open_now.all_full_line: New seats get posted in #open-seats on our Discord. Hop in, say hoy, and you'll see the next one.

gold_glory.title: Gold & Glory
gold_glory.label: Come for the game. Stay for the people.
pitch: Gold & Glory is where the game keeps going after the session ends: a friendly, inclusive crew of players and GMs from all over the world.
Make friends at other tables in weekly $5 one-shots, find your next campaign, and join the board game nights, streams, and watch parties.
400+ members, and there's always room for one more.

art_teaser.title: Art & Zines
art_teaser.line: Made by hand. Maps, monsters, and weird little adventures you can hold.

games_page.title: The Tables
games_page.intro: Weekly online games, story first, with times shown in your time zone. New players are always welcome. We'll roll up characters together and I'll teach as we go.

session.heading: [LOREM — copy slot: session strip heading]
session.line: Every week we gather in Discord voice, play on Owlbear Rodeo, and tell a story for about three hours.

steps.title: Show up.
steps.text: Audio on Discord, maps and tokens on Owlbear Rodeo. Just a browser and a mic.

steps.title: Play.
steps.text: We make characters together at session zero. Never played? Perfect.

bottom.line: Nothing fits your week? New tables and open seats get posted in #open-seats.

art_page.title: Art & Zines
art_page.intro: Everything here is drawn by hand for the table: maps, tokens, portraits, and the odd weird little zine. No AI, ever.
